items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: "Do you know Earl Hines?" I said, "No, I don't." ... "I want him to play a little afternoon for me, like two or three tunes."

ctx.x: I'd say When they said black, you're the one, baby. So he says to me, "I've heard some talk about you." I said, "Yeah, was it good?" Say, "Yeah but I heard Earl Hines is in town." Earl Hines was doing a similar thing like Louis, like Pops was doing. Come to St. Louis on a Sunday afternoon, Sunday night. Lovely, I'll get back to Louis Armstrong later. And, that's the first time I heard of All Hal Baker. He says he doesn't even remember. I said you've got a tremendous trumpet player like that. So, what happened…
Well, the guy says, "Do you know where Earl Hines is?" And you say, well, I know he'll be one of two places.
